subject: Can you make it disappear?
body:
Someone left a brutal 1-star review of Pug Café on Yowl and it's dragging the whole page down. espresso_or_death, whoever that is. Can you just... make it go away? I'll pay 30.

Brynn

outcomes.when: the player agrees to get the review removed, or says they're on it
outcomes.reply: Thank you. Tell me when it's gone.

hints: I know it's not technically my review to delete. That's why I'm offering 30. It's the one by espresso_or_death on Yowl.

hack.goal: delete the 1-star review espresso_or_death left on Pug Café's Yowl page

path.name: Yowl
path.description: the review site yowl.com where the review is

path.name: Pug Café
path.description: Pug's 24/7 café at 3 Linden Ave, run by Brynn LeClaire, the business the review is about

path.name: espresso_or_death
path.description: the username of the Yowl account that wrote the review

hack.reply: You're a lifesaver. It's gone — thank you. I'll send the 30 tonight.
